name: After § 5
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on energy-intensive industries
part_text: 5a. Stresses that the availability of abundant, affordable, and renewable energy is a prerequisite for the green industrial transition and decarbonisation of energy-intensive industries; notes that key energy infrastructure and strategic investments are currently subject to market volatility rather than long-term public planning; calls on the Commission and Member States to adopt a strategy to bring essential energy production under democratic and public control, ensuring that investments in renewable energy production and emerging technologies are driven by public interest rather than short-term profit motives, guaranteeing stable energy prices for EIIs and securing a sustainable and resilient energy supply for industries and society as a whole;
